name: 피츄
scene: At a sunlit urban power-station rooftop with clean yellow railings and distant city skyline, upright balanced card stance, face toward camera, both empty hands relaxed open beside her hips and fully separate from the torso.
motifs: Pichu’s black-tipped triangular ears become a small angular headpiece, the jagged black neck marking becomes a pointed dark collar, the pink cheek circles become small pink round ornaments, and the short black angular tail becomes a short black belt sash

casual.scene: In a sunlit home sewing room in late morning, standing beside a dressing table and tying a small ribbon into her hair with both hands beside her head. Face fully unobstructed, warm window light, fabric rolls behind her, no mirror.
casual.outfit: Opaque lined pale-yellow satin camisole with secure square neckline and broad straps, matching high-waisted lounge shorts below crop, an open soft black cotton robe draped below the shoulders. Bare shoulders arms and a small midriff gap; tiny pink ribbon hair accessory, no armor.

casual.scene: In a bright community bicycle-repair courtyard at midday, kneeling beside a plain bicycle with both hands clearly visible as she seats a small tire pump hose on a valve. Balanced supported posture, full head and feet inside frame, no other people or signage.
casual.outfit: Opaque black sleeveless fitted utility top, yellow high-waisted work shorts and flat canvas shoes. Bare arms shoulders and legs, tiny pink ear studs, no gloves, no armor.

casual.scene: At a quiet open-air berry preserve stall in rosy evening light, side-on spooning a berry mixture into a small glass jar with one hand while the other steadies the jar on the counter. Face readable in profile, both hands distinct, unlabelled jars and fruit baskets.
casual.outfit: Opaque ivory sleeveless peplum blouse with secure scoop neckline, pale-yellow high-waisted skirt with a short black waist apron. Bare shoulders arms and lower legs, tiny pink circular pendant, no armor.
